blocks.text: Product Description               Moving heavy furniture doesn't have to be such a headache. With the Super Sliders Rectangle Reusable Furniture Sliders, you can move even your largest furniture pieces and heaviest household items with ease. Made for use on area rugs or high or low pile carpet, these heavy-duty furniture pads let you glide beds, sofas, dressers, tables, bookshelves, heavy appliances, and more smoothly without strain or damage. The durable plastic base offers long-lasting strength and effortless sliding, while the thick rubber foam top grips furniture legs securely without sticking or leaving residue. For optimal convenience, you can keep these furniture mover pads underneath your furniture to make everyday activities a little easier, such as vacuuming and cleaning around your home or rearranging furniture. Reusable and built to last, these heavy moving pads protect both your carpeted surfaces and your furniture bases from wear, scuffs, and snags while making heavy lifting a one-person job. For best results, carefully slide the mover pads underneath your furniture (foam-side up) and center below the furniture leg or foot for a secure grip and evenly distributed weight.                  From the Manufacturer               Super Sliders feature distinctive packaging and complete surface protection for your home or office. Combined with superior quality, innovation and longevity for all your furniture and floor protection needs.
